finding: A 1955 Cairo Dar al-Kutub catalog identifies a three-part Ma'ani al-Qur'an edition, with 1,384 total pages and part 3 listed as 408 pages. Since the poem is in the Kawthar discussion and that edition's part 3 has a page 377, KSU's bare citation (377) could refer to part 3 page 377 of this edition. This is a plausible bibliographic candidate, not a verified identification: the scanned part-three PDF was previously unavailable because the download exceeded the current reader limit, and KSU does not name the edition or volume. A different cataloged/editorial path is also reported with a shorter third part, demonstrating edition-dependent pagination. A second catalog path credits the full work to Najati, al-Najjar, and al-Shalabi, reinforcing that editor attribution must be checked at volume level rather than inferred from a shortened whole-work catalog record.
